title: Le Podcast de Prêt à Parler
author: Prêt à Parler - Le Podcast
description: Ready to improve your French? We are bringing you pronunciation tips, conversation skills improvement hacks with our teachers Brice and Sandra, there will also be ways for you to discover the beautiful francophone literature, poetry, the most famous and less famous authors with "La chronique de Catherine". And with Isabelle you will learn more about francophone music and improve your pronunciation. For all French levels! Hébergé par Ausha. Visitez ausha.co/fr/politique-de-confidentialite pour plus d'informations.
